title: Molecular Insights into the Calcium Binding in Troponin C Through a Molecular Dynamics Study
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究肌钙蛋白C中EF-hand钙离子结合机制，虽涉及转录因子调控背景，但核心是蛋白-钙离子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或DNA结合建模方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Calcium-binding proteins play critical roles in various biological processes such as signal transduction, cell growth, and transcription factor regulation. Ion binding and target binding of Ca2+-binding proteins are highly related. Therefore, understanding the ion binding mechanism will benefit the relevant inhibitor design towards the Ca2+ binding proteins. The EF-hand is the typical ion binding motif in Ca2+-binding proteins. Previous studies indicate that the ion binding affinity of the EF-hand increases with peptide length, but this mechanism has not been fully established. Herein, using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, thermodynamic integration (TI) calculations, and molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area (MMPBSA) analysis, we systematically investigated four Ca2+ binding peptides containing the EF-hand loop in the site III of rabbit skeletal troponin C (TnC). These four peptides have 13, 21, 26, and 34 residues, respectively. Our simulations reproduced the observed trend that the ion binding affinity increases with peptide length. Our results implied that the E-helix motif preceding the EF-hand loop, especially the Phe99 residue, plays a significant role in this regulation. The E-helix has a significant impact on the backbone and sidechain conformations of the Asp103 residue, rigidifying important hydrogen bonds in the EF-hand and decreasing the solvent exposure of the Ca2+ ion, hence leading to more favorable Ca2+ binding in longer peptides. The present study provides molecular insights into the ion binding in the EF-hand and establishes an important step towards elucidating the responses of Ca2+-binding proteins towards the ion and target availability.
abstract_zh: 钙结合蛋白在信号转导、细胞生长及转录因子调控等多种生物过程中发挥关键作用。Ca2+结合蛋白的离子结合与靶标结合高度相关。因此，理解离子结合机制将有助于针对Ca2+结合蛋白的相关抑制剂设计。EF-hand是Ca2+结合蛋白中典型的离子结合基序。先前研究表明，EF-hand的离子结合亲和力随肽段长度增加而增强，但该机制尚未完全确立。本研究利用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟、热力学积分 (thermodynamic integration, TI) 计算及分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积 (molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area, MMPBSA) 分析，系统研究了兔骨骼肌肌钙蛋白C (TnC) 位点III中包含EF-hand环的四个Ca2+结合肽段。这四个肽段分别含有13、21、26和34个残基。我们的模拟重现了离子结合亲和力随肽段长度增加而增强的观察趋势。结果表明，EF-hand环之前的E-螺旋基序，尤其是Phe99残基，在此调控中发挥重要作用。E-螺旋对Asp103残基的主链和侧链构象有显著影响，使EF-hand中关键氢键刚性化，并降低Ca2+离子的溶剂暴露度，从而导致较长肽段中Ca2+结合更有利。本研究为EF-hand中的离子结合提供了分子层面的见解，并朝着阐明Ca2+结合蛋白对离子及靶标可用性的响应迈出了重要一步。
